# JOC Japan Travel

> > Japan travel guides and cultural insights covering Kyoto temples, Hokkaido ski resorts, Kyushu castles, and authentic local dining experiences across all regions.

JOC Japan Travel is a comprehensive travel resource created by Shen Chen (Mr. JOC) and Andy Cheng, featuring detailed destination guides, restaurant reviews, and family-friendly itineraries across Japan's major regions including Kansai, Kyushu, Chubu, and Hokkaido. The site emphasizes authentic cultural experiences, from UNESCO heritage sites to local udon shops.

## Key Topics

- Kyoto temples and shrines
- Kyushu regional travel
- Kansai Region destinations
- Hokkaido attractions
- Chubu Region guides
- Family-friendly activities
- Restaurant and sushi reviews
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Japanese castle tourism
- Traditional festivals (matsuri)
- Onsen and ski resorts
- Historic districts and old towns
- Japanese cuisine guides
- Day trips from Tokyo
- Samurai and feudal history

## Kyoto & Kansai Highlights

- [East Kyoto](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/destination/east-kyoto): Destination hub for Higashiyama, Fushimi Inari & Philosopher's Path
- [Fushimi Inari Taisha – Walking Through Kyoto's Thousand Torii Gates](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-kyoto-fushimi-inari-taisha): Kyoto's iconic shrine with thousands of torii gates on Mount Inari
- [What to Eat in Kyoto – 12 Must-Try Local Foods](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-kyoto-what-to-eat): Kyoto food guide: nishin soba, saba zushi, kaiseki & matcha desserts
- [Where to Eat in Dotonbori – Osaka's Street Food and Dining Guide](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-osaka-where-to-eat-dotonbori): Osaka's neon-lit food district guide: crab, Kobe beef, okonomiyaki
- [Horyu-ji – Exploring the World's Oldest Wooden Buildings in Nara](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-nara-horyu-ji): UNESCO temple in Nara with world's oldest wooden structures

## Kyushu Region Travel

- [Kumamoto Castle Guide – Kyushu's Reborn Samurai Fortress](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kyushu-kumamoto-castle): Kumamoto Castle restoration guide after 2016 earthquake
- [Where to Stay in Fukuoka – Budget and Comfort Picks in Tenjin](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kyushu-fukuoka-hotels): Hotel reviews: Hotel CASVI Tenjin & Hotel Monterey Fukuoka
- [Yamanaka Sushi – Omakase Dining Without Leaving Hakata Station](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kyushu-fukuoka-yamanaka): Premium omakase sushi inside Hakata Station, Fukuoka
- [Museum of the 26 Martyrs – Faith and Persecution in Nagasaki](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kyushu-nagasaki-museum-26-martyrs): Christian persecution history museum on Nishizaka Hill, Nagasaki
- [Yakudon Noodle House – Comforting Udon and Rice Bowls in Yakushima](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kyushu-kagoshima-yakushima-yakudon-noodle-house): Local udon restaurant in Anbo, Yakushima island

## Chubu Region & UNESCO Heritage

- [Visiting Shirakawa-go – Japan's Thatched Roof Heritage Village](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-shirakawa-go-village): UNESCO village in Gifu with gassho-zukuri farmhouses
- [Takayama Travel Guide – Markets, Temples, and Old Town Streets](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-takayama-travel-guide): Edo-period streets, morning markets & Hida beef in Gifu Prefecture
- [Atsuta Shrine Guide – Nagoya's Sacred Shinto Site](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-aichi-nagoya-atsuta-shrine): Sacred Nagoya shrine with imperial legends & 1,000-year-old tree
- [Hakuba Ski Trip – Family Guide to Nagano's Winter Wonderland](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-nagano-hakuba-ski-guide): Family ski guide for Hakuba Valley with budget tips & onsen

## Hokkaido Attractions

- [Historical Village of Hokkaido – An Open-Air Museum of Pioneer Life](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/hokkaido-sapporo-historical-village): Open-air museum in Sapporo with 50+ Meiji/Taisho era buildings
- [Sapporo TV Tower – Classic Views Over Hokkaido's Capital](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/hokkaido-sapporo-tv-tower): Observation deck overlooking Odori Park in downtown Sapporo

## Tokyo & Kanto Day Trips

- [Kaiten Sushi Toriton – Best Conveyor Belt Sushi in Tokyo](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/tokyo-skytree-sushi-toriton): Hokkaido-style kaiten sushi at Tokyo Skytree Town
- [Kamakura – A Historic Seaside Escape from Tokyo](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kanto-kanagawa-kamakura-travel-guide): Day trip guide: temples, bamboo groves & samurai history near Tokyo

## Optional

- [Izunokuni Fireworks Festival – A Riverside Summer Celebration](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-shizuoka-izu-izunokuni-fireworks): Summer matsuri along Kano River on Izu Peninsula
- [Makaino Farm Resort – Animals, Dairy, and Outdoor Play](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-shizuoka-makaino-farm-resort): Family farm near Mt. Fuji with animal petting & pony rides
